question: Across a frozen census of public multi-vector visual retriever releases already mirrored by 2026-08-22, which checkpoint updates preserve a post-vision replay boundary, and does that legal boundary imply a useful physical plan?

census.selection_boundary: Public checkpoints that were already mirrored on the authoritative A100 data volume before this protocol was frozen. The census is intentionally small and descriptive; it is not a production-frequency sample.

inspection.checkpoint: Read the safetensors header without loading tensor payloads; hash the complete checkpoint; classify every tensor as vision, base_embedding, decoder_adapter, retrieval_projection, or unknown.
inspection.processor: Hash packaged preprocessor_config.json when present. A changed or missing processor package blocks unconditional whole-package prefix reuse even when adapter tensors themselves are replayable.
inspection.transition: A transition is post-vision replay-legal only if source and target share a base contract, target tensors contain no vision/base-embedding/unknown dependency, and the processor is explicitly pinned or observed equivalent.

measured_cost_profiles.colqwen2_5: Complete-MMDocIR raw 5000.183300813542 s, PCA256 replay 1243.8262620323803 s, IR 6266593554 bytes, terminal 6369873920 bytes.
measured_cost_profiles.colpali: Held-out 128-page raw 4.554119373341867 s, exact replay 3.704416881334813 s, exact IR/terminal 12.56396010315534x; complete Energy PCA256-INT8 replay saves 5.89% and fails the frozen quality/execution gate.

gates.reality: At least two official consecutive version transitions must be adapter/projection-only after tensor inspection.
gates.counterexample: At least one public adapter must invalidate post-vision replay, demonstrating that labels are insufficient.
gates.payoff_boundary: Report replay legality separately from measured storage/time admission; do not count a legal but rejected ColPali boundary as a system win.
gates.claim: Promote observed-update support only as a bounded release-history characterization; never infer production update frequency from this census.
